x-fal-metadata.about:
# VEED Clean Audio

Removes background noise from speech recordings. This is the model behind the **Clean Audio** toggle in
the VEED editor, where it has processed every recording since August 2026: MossFormer2 speech
enhancement at 48 kHz, followed by VEED's post chain — a speech-gated suppression floor that keeps quiet
and distant words instead of cutting them, presence/air EQ, and BS.1770 loudness normalization.

## Input
- **audio_url**: any audio or video ffmpeg can decode (wav, mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, mp4, mov, webm, ...).
A video's audio track is used (to get the video back with the cleaned track, call **/video**);
multi-channel input is mixed down to mono.
- Up to **30 minutes** of audio and **512 MB** per file. Public URLs only (private networks and
cloud metadata addresses are refused; redirects are not followed) or a data URI.
- Processing takes roughly 0.2–0.5× the audio duration: a 10-minute file returns in 2–5 minutes.

## Output
- 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM in **FLAC** (default) or **WAV**, same duration as the input.
- Integrated loudness **−19 LUFS**, true peak **≤ −1.1 dBTP** (skip by passing target_lufs = null).

## Pricing
**1 unit = 1 minute of input audio.** The duration is rounded to whole seconds, then up to the next
full minute; minimum 1 unit. A 5:00.011 file is 5 units, a 5:01 file is 6. Failed requests are not
billed.

## Errors
Invalid input returns HTTP 422 with the offending field: unreachable or non-public audio_url, no
audio track, more than 30 minutes or 512 MB, undecodable audio.
